questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did Allen Iverson's 2000–01 76ers win?
questions.note: Larry Brown won Coach of the Year and Iverson led Philadelphia to the Finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 76ers finished in first place in the Atlantic Division with a 56–26 record

funFacts.text: Philadelphia traded Theo Ratliff, Toni Kukoč and Nazr Mohammed to Atlanta for center Dikembe Mutombo during the season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the team traded Theo Ratliff, Toni Kukoč, and Nazr Mohammed to the Atlanta Hawks in exchange for All-Star center Dikembe Mutombo

funFacts.text: Larry Brown was named NBA Coach of the Year as Philadelphia improved by seven wins over the previous season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Head coach Larry Brown was named the NBA Coach of the Year, after leading the 76ers to a seven-game improvement

funFacts.text: The Sixers changed the look of their white home and black road uniforms that season, including the lettering and collar design.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)

questions.prompt: Wilt Chamberlain finished with 100 points against the Knicks in March 1962. How many did he have at halftime?
questions.context: Philadelphia Warriors vs New York Knicks · Hershey, Pennsylvania
questions.note: The Warriors led only 79–68 at the break; Wilt scored 59 after it, 31 in the fourth quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Chamberlain's point total stood at 41.

funFacts.text: Even so, Philadelphia led by only 11 at the break.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: but still led 79–68

funFacts.text: After three quarters Wilt had 69, nine short of his own scoring record.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: His own total stood at 69, nine shy of his previous scoring record.

funFacts.text: He made 28 of 32 free throws, far above his usual rate.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Chamberlain made 36 of 63 field-goals and 28 of 32

questions.prompt: Chicago opened 1995–96 with 37 straight home wins. How long did that home winning streak run in total?
questions.note: An NBA record at the time; Chicago finished that season 39–2 at the United Center.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Bulls' started the regular season 37–0 at home, part of a then-NBA-record 44-game winning streak

funFacts.text: Chicago opened the regular season undefeated at home for its first 37 contests.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Bulls' started the regular season 37–0 at home

funFacts.text: The team finished that regular season with a spectacular 39–2 record at the United Center.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the team also posted a league-best 39–2 home record at the United Center

funFacts.text: The Bulls introduced black alternate road uniforms with red pinstripes for the 1995–96 season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: new black alternate road uniforms, which featured red pinstripes

questions.prompt: The chart shows blocks on three other famous two-way nights. How many did Tim Duncan block in his near quadruple-double in 2003?

questions.note: With 21 points, 20 rebounds and 10 assists, as David Robinson retired a champion.

questions.prompt: The chart shows two other Game 7 scoring nights. How many points did Kawhi Leonard score in his 2019 Game 7 against Philadelphia?
questions.note: On 16-of-39 shooting, capped by the first Game 7 buzzer-beater in NBA history.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
